The '''University of Reles''' was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Reles]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. On the outskirts of the university's campus was the [[Museum of Spintir]], which housed [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Caria Haal|Haal's]] personal collection, including a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] governor arranged for this by getting grants for the university from the Empire. It was known to have produced prominent galactic scholars who came from humble local beginnings with the help of the university's generous scholarships.<ref name="LotL" />

The University of Reles had an archive of the genetic data on the [[Species/Legends|species]] of Spintir, and studies were attempted to determine why there was such a high percentage of [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] species on the planet.<ref name="LotL" />
